gloss: Western tableware; Western-style dishes and utensils

definitions.gloss: Western tableware; Western-style dishes and utensils
definitions.explanation: Tableware designed in Western style, including plates, knives, forks, spoons, and glasses, as distinct from traditional Japanese tableware.

examples.japanese: {洋食器|ようしょっき}を{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I got a set of Western tableware.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{祝|いわ}いに{洋食器|ようしょっき}のセットを{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I gave a set of Western tableware as a wedding gift.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}では{和食器|わしょっき}と{洋食器|ようしょっき}の{両方|りょうほう}を{取|と}り{扱|あつか}っているので、{食卓|しょくたく}のスタイルに{合|あ}わせて{選|えら}べる。
examples.english: This store carries both Japanese and Western tableware, so you can choose to match your dining style.

notes:
A compound of {洋|よう} (Western) and {食器|しょっき} (tableware). In Japan, both Western and Japanese tableware are commonly used in homes. {洋食器|ようしょっき} typically refers to flat plates, soup bowls, knives, forks, spoons, wine glasses, and similar items.

Western tableware sets are popular wedding gifts in Japan. Well-known brands include both imported European makers and Japanese manufacturers like Noritake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋食器|ようしょっき}のセット: Western tableware set
- {洋食器|ようしょっき}{売|う}り{場|ば}: Western tableware section (in a department store)
- {高級|こうきゅう}{洋食器|ようしょっき}: fine Western tableware

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和食器|わしょっき}: Japanese tableware — bowls, chopsticks, small plates, and other traditional items
- {食器|しょっき}: tableware, dishes — the general term covering all types
